families.first_buy: first non-launch buy: the dust bot at +3 in 7/7. First real buy (>= 0.0002): 7/7 at +140/177/210 (p10/50/90), 0.16/0.16/0.2 ETH; 6/7 are the 'scheduled' candidate: a round-size buy (0.16 x3, 0.2 x2, 0.18; 0.15 x2 in the sibling at +135/+139) through router 0x75379d5d2ea4c98aeaa57f32e233707550ab03f0 (UR-style execute 3593564c, 1,540 bytes, value 0), each from a DIFFERENT high-nonce wallet (nonces 1,686-4,144) never seen in any other pool's first 8 swaps (8 wallets / 8 pools); the 7th pool's first real buy is a 0.008 ETH sniper (0x81586f00) at +15 and it never gets the 0x75379d5d buy. Then a crowd (recurring small wallets 0x0b410a5f, 0x1a2d2cd5, 0xe9d83e95 via 0x4f881c6a, more 0x75379d5d wallets with 0.1-0.3 ETH) buys from +150 to +400; 0.3-7 ETH of buys per pool in 3,000 blocks
families.pull: 0/7 pulled within 3,000 blocks (0/9 with the sibling; the liquidity never moves). The pull's role is taken by the launcher selling its 1.5 ETH bag: seen in the first 8 swaps in 2/7 (+18 before the router buy, +195 in the pool that never got it, 1.494 and 1.499 ETH out); the other pools' big sells (unattributed, beyond the census' first 8 txs) come at +462 (1.67 ETH), +1222 (2.62), +2152 (1.44), +619 (2.27, sibling) or not in the window
families.outsiders: no outsider of any size before the 0x75379d5d buy in the 6 pools that got it (only the dust bot). These ride a crowd that keeps buying 150-400 blocks in, not a schedule of the operator's own (the router buyers are distinct wallets each launch), with the launcher's 1.5 ETH bag over the position for 10-20 s; 4.5 launches a day caps it at ~$5 a day at $15. The structure the owner wants (own buy at fixed blocks with slack, pull a fixed margin after) is absent.
